Technical analysis utilises a number of different indicators to predict the future movement of an asset price, these include Moving Averages, MACD, Fibonacci Retracements, Bollinger Bands and RSI. Each of these indicators use a unique mathematical formula to generate a value that is then plotted as a line on a chart. In this instance, these values have been converted into a score out of 10, with 10 being the most bullish (indicative of a strong possibility of a rise in price) and 0 being the most bearish (indicative of a strong possibility of a price decrease).

Based on these indicator scores, the overall trend is considered to be upward, with a low risk level and overall risk being low. The decision is to BUY the asset covered by the data.
